recipes.title: Berry Yogurt Breakfast Bowl
recipes.subtitle: Creamy Greek Yogurt with Fresh Berries & Granola
recipes.description: Creamy Greek yogurt topped with fresh berries, crunchy granola, honey, and a sprinkle of chia seeds.

hero_image.alt: Greek yogurt bowl with berries and granola

introduction: A creamy, refreshing breakfast that takes just minutes to put together.
Greek yogurt adds protein while berries and granola bring freshness and crunch.

dos.title: Add Granola Last
dos.text: Add granola just before serving so it stays crunchy.

donts.title: Overload with Toppings
donts.text: Keep the toppings balanced so the yogurt remains the star.

recipes.instructions_overview: Add Greek yogurt to a bowl and top with berries, granola, honey, and chia seeds.

instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, granola, honey, and chia seeds.

general: Drink: Coffee, green tea, or fresh orange juice.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh, creamy, and ready in five minutes.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu & Avocado Wrap
recipes.subtitle: Pan-Seared Tofu Wrap with Creamy Avocado & Lime
recipes.description: Golden crispy tofu, creamy sliced avocado, crisp romaine lettuce, and dairy-free garlic mayo rolled into a warm whole-wheat wrap.
introduction: A fast, plant-based wrap loaded with savory protein and healthy fats.
Pan-seared tofu provides crunch without long cooking times.

dos.title: Press the Tofu
dos.text: Pat tofu dry with a towel so it browns and turns golden quickly in the pan.

donts.title: Overfill the Wrap
donts.text: Keep ingredients centered to ensure a tight, mess-free roll.

recipes.instructions_overview: Sear seasoned tofu slices until golden, then wrap with avocado, lettuce, and vegan garlic mayo.

instructions: Sear tofu slices in olive oil with garlic powder, salt, and pepper for 5 minutes until crispy.
Spread vegan mayo over tortilla, layer tofu, avocado, and lettuce, sprinkle lime juice, and roll tightly.

general: Serve with baked vegetable chips or lemon sparkling water.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Crispy, savory, and ready in ten minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken Rice Bowl
recipes.subtitle: Tender Chicken with Steamed Rice & Vegetables
recipes.description: Juicy chicken pieces glazed with honey and garlic served over fluffy rice with crisp vegetables.
introduction: A simple chicken bowl with a sweet-savory glaze and plenty of colorful vegetables.
Perfect for a satisfying lunch or easy weeknight dinner.

dos.title: Cut Chicken Evenly
dos.text: Uniform pieces cook at the same rate and stay juicy.

donts.title: Overcook the Chicken
donts.text: Remove the chicken once fully cooked to keep it tender.

recipes.instructions_overview: Cook chicken with garlic, honey, and soy sauce, then serve over rice with steamed vegetables.

instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in olive oil until golden.
Add garlic, honey, and soy sauce and cook until the chicken is coated.
Add cooked rice to a bowl.
Top with chicken and steamed vegetables.

pairing_suggestions.summary: Balanced, filling, and easy enough for a weeknight.

recipes.title: Tuna & Avocado Wrap
recipes.subtitle: Fresh Tuna Salad with Creamy Avocado
recipes.description: A quick tortilla wrap filled with tuna, avocado, lettuce, tomato, and lemon.
introduction: A fresh protein-packed wrap that requires no cooking.
Creamy avocado balances the savory tuna while crisp vegetables add texture.

dos.title: Drain Tuna Well
dos.text: Removing excess liquid keeps the tortilla from becoming soggy.

donts.title: Overfill the Wrap
donts.text: Leave enough space around the edges to roll it tightly.

recipes.instructions_overview: Mix tuna with Greek yogurt and lemon, then layer with avocado and vegetables inside a tortilla.

instructions: Mix drained tuna with Greek yogurt, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mixture over the tortilla.
Add avocado, tomato, and lettuce.
Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.

general: Serve with fresh fruit or a small side salad.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato & Basil Pasta
recipes.subtitle: Garlic Tomato Pasta with Coconut Cream & Basil
recipes.description: Comforting pasta tossed in a silky vegan tomato sauce made with garlic, coconut cream, fresh basil, and nutritional yeast.
introduction: A quick plant-based comfort-food classic made with simple pantry ingredients.
Coconut cream and nutritional yeast provide a rich, savory texture without any dairy.

dos.title: Save Pasta Water
dos.text: A splash of starchy pasta water helps loosen and emulsify the sauce.

donts.title: Overcook the Pasta
donts.text: Cook until al dente so the pasta keeps its texture.

recipes.instructions_overview: Cook pasta al dente, simmer garlic tomato passata with coconut cream and nutritional yeast, then toss together.

instructions: Sauté garlic in olive oil for one minute.
Add tomato passata and simmer for five minutes before stirring in coconut cream and nutritional yeast.
Add cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water to the sauce.
Toss well and garnish with fresh basil.

general: Serve with a simple green salad.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Creamy, comforting, and ready in twenty minutes.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Pita
recipes.subtitle: Grilled Chicken with Tzatziki & Fresh Vegetables
recipes.description: Warm pita filled with seasoned chicken, crisp lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and creamy tzatziki.
introduction: A fresh Mediterranean-inspired meal with juicy chicken and crunchy vegetables.
Perfect for lunch or dinner.

dos.title: Warm the Pita
dos.text: Heating the pita briefly makes it softer and easier to fold.

donts.title: Add Too Much Sauce
donts.text: A moderate amount of tzatziki keeps the pita from becoming soggy.

recipes.instructions_overview: Season and cook the chicken, slice the vegetables, then fill warm pita bread with all ingredients.

instructions: Season chicken with oregano, salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Cook in a hot grill pan until golden and fully cooked.
Warm the pita briefly.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, chicken, and tzatziki.

general: Serve with sparkling water and lemon.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh Mediterranean flavors in a convenient handheld meal.

recipes.title: Avocado & Egg Toast
recipes.subtitle: Sourdough Toast with Soft Scrambled Egg
recipes.description: Crispy sourdough topped with creamy avocado, soft scrambled egg, chili flakes, and fresh herbs.
introduction: A more filling take on classic avocado toast with creamy scrambled egg.
It is quick enough for breakfast but satisfying enough to keep you going.

dos.title: Cook Eggs Gently
dos.text: Low heat keeps scrambled eggs soft and creamy.

donts.title: Overcook the Eggs
donts.text: Remove them from heat while they still look slightly glossy.

recipes.instructions_overview: Toast the bread, mash the avocado, then top with gently scrambled eggs and seasonings.

instructions: Toast the sourdough and mash avocado with lemon juice.
Scramble eggs gently in olive oil until soft.
Spread avocado over the toast.
Top with scrambled egg, chili flakes, parsley, salt, and pepper.

general: Drink: Coffee or fresh orange juice.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Creamy, savory, and packed with protein.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.subtitle: Fresh Herb & Lemon Chickpea Bowl
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and chickpeas tossed with lemon, oregano, and olive oil.
introduction: A colorful Mediterranean salad that requires no cooking.
Fresh vegetables and chickpeas make it light but satisfying.

dos.title: Rinse Chickpeas
dos.text: Rinse canned chickpeas thoroughly before adding them.

donts.title: Dress Too Early
donts.text: Add dressing shortly before serving to keep the vegetables crisp.

recipes.instructions_overview: Chop vegetables, combine with chickpeas, and toss with lemon, olive oil, and oregano.

instructions: Add chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, and olives to a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad.
Toss well and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Bites
recipes.subtitle: Frozen Banana & Peanut Butter Treats
recipes.description: Sweet banana slices layered with creamy peanut butter and dark chocolate.
introduction: A simple frozen treat made from banana, peanut butter, and dark chocolate.
Perfect when you want something sweet without baking.

dos.title: Use Ripe Bananas
dos.text: Ripe bananas provide natural sweetness and a creamy texture.

donts.title: Use Too Much Chocolate
donts.text: A thin chocolate coating keeps the bites balanced rather than overly heavy.

recipes.instructions_overview: Slice bananas, sandwich with peanut butter, coat with melted chocolate, and freeze until firm.

instructions: Slice bananas and place a small amount of peanut butter between slices.
Dip or drizzle with melted dark chocolate.
Place bites on parchment paper.
Freeze for at least one hour before serving.

pairing_suggestions.summary: A sweet, chocolatey snack with no baking required.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Bites
recipes.subtitle: Frozen Stuffed Strawberries with Graham Cracker Crunch
recipes.description: Fresh strawberries stuffed with a sweetened cream cheese filling, dipped in melted chocolate, and sprinkled with crushed graham crackers.
introduction: A bite-sized, non-baked dessert combining fresh berries and rich cheesecake filling.
Quick to assemble and perfect for a light, refreshing treat out of the freezer.

dos.title: Dry the Strawberries
dos.text: Ensure strawberries are completely dry after washing so the chocolate and filling stick well.

donts.title: Overfill the Berries
donts.text: Fill just flush with the top of the berry so the chocolate coating stays neat.

recipes.instructions_overview: Hollow out strawberries, whip cream cheese filling, stuff berries, dip in melted chocolate, sprinkle with crushed crackers, and chill.

image.alt: Stuffed strawberries with cream cheese filling

instructions: Hollow out the center of each strawberry using a paring knife.
In a small bowl, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling into each strawberry.
Dip the bottoms or drizzle the tops with melted chocolate.
Sprinkle immediately with crushed graham crackers.
Place on parchment paper and freeze for 30–45 minutes before serving.

general: Drink: Cold milk, iced coffee, or dessert wine.
pairing_suggestions.summary: A creamy, fruity, bite-sized indulgence with zero baking required.

recipes.title: Salmon & Avocado Rice Bowl
recipes.subtitle: Roasted Salmon with Rice, Avocado & Cucumber
recipes.description: Flaky roasted salmon served over rice with creamy avocado, cucumber, sesame, and lemon.
introduction: A colorful bowl combining tender salmon with fresh vegetables and fluffy rice.
A balanced option for lunch or dinner when you want something nourishing but substantial.

dos.title: Check the Center
dos.text: Cook salmon until the center flakes easily and reaches a safe internal temperature.

donts.title: Overcook the Salmon
donts.text: Avoid leaving salmon in the oven longer than necessary so it stays moist.

recipes.instructions_overview: Roast seasoned salmon, prepare rice and vegetables, then assemble everything into a bowl.

instructions: Season salmon with olive oil, lemon, salt, and pepper.
Roast until flaky and fully cooked.
Add rice to bowls.
Top with salmon, avocado, cucumber, sesame seeds, and lemon.

pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh, colorful, and packed with satisfying protein.
